split_rule: Prompts are tuned only on dev_cases. Every other case is the held-out test set and is looked at only to report results.
labelling_rules: matched = the CV states the skill, or states something that directly implies it (a product for its category, a library for its language, an equal or higher level).
missing = no evidence, only a wish or plan, an explicit negation, a level below the requirement, or an amount of experience the CV does not let you work out.
Compound requirements are labelled as separate items; 'X or Y' alternatives stay one item.
Soft skills are matched only when the CV names them.
